name: tarangos
description: TarangOS — a private, secure, local-first personal productivity system.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install && npm run db:push
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix server run db:deploy && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
